messages:
Erin (Support): Heads-up — Silverline invoice autopay failed again (invoice 8142). Gateway returned a soft-decline and the ACS challenge URL ended with HTTP 403. Customer sees a redirect loop then decline. Logs attached. Can payments/runtime triage?
Sam (Payments-Eng): Txn id? env?
Erin (Support): txn_5K8yWzqH at 2026-03-12T16:52:11Z, env=prod, merchant=silverline-prod. Gateway (brickpay) trace shows: challenge redirect -> 403 from ACS, acquirer_code=ACS_403. Customer says it started after a CDN change last week.
payments-bot: Charge failed. code=SOFT_DECLINE_3DS, acquirer=brickpay, acquirer_code=ACS_403, last_http_status=403, route=autopay-default
Marta (Runtime-Eng): Can you paste the redirect request/response headers from the gateway trace? Suspect cookie or CSP issue on challenge flow.
Erin (Support): Pasted headers from gateway trace: ``
Request: POST /acs/challenge HTTP/1.1
Host: acs-uk.bank.example
Referer: https://checkout.silverline.co/3ds-redirect
Cookie: session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Chrome)

Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: text/html
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://merchant.silverline.co
Set-Cookie: acs_session=abc123; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax
```
Marta (Runtime-Eng): That looks like the issue. ACS is setting cookies with SameSite=Lax which means the browser won't send them on a cross-site POST during the challenge redirect. On autopay we originate from a different site context, so the ACS sees no valid session and returns 403. The CDN change mention fits — some edge rewrites can change headers.
Marta (Runtime-Eng): Quick repro steps I ran locally (use test card that requires 3DS):
``
# simulate merchant autopay -> gateway -> acs redirect
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -d "{\"amount\":1000,\"card_token\":\"tok_3ds_required\",\"merchant_id\":\"silverline-test\",\"autopay\":true}"
```
Then follow the redirect URL returned by gateway and observe cookies. If Set-Cookie uses SameSite=Lax the second POST from the redirect flow drops the cookie.
Marta (Runtime-Eng): Two options: 
- Short term: route Silverline autopay to alternate acquirer (fastpay) that does same-session 3DS handling. We'll push a routing rule to their merchant profile.
- Long term: ask Brickpay/acquirer and/or ACS vendor to set challenge cookies to SameSite=None; Secure and ensure CSP/frame-ancestors include the merchant origin used for redirects, or update the merchant's CDN to avoid rewriting Set-Cookie/SameSite.
Sam (Payments-Eng): I'll open an acquirer ticket with Brickpay and add logs + repro steps. Also adding a routing override to prod for silverline-prod to use fastpay for autopays; will monitor for next 24h.
Erin (Support): Thanks. I'll tell Silverline the temporary workaround (route to alternate acquirer) and that we're escalating for a permanent fix.
Silverline-CS: Appreciate the quick triage — please cc me once Brickpay ticket is created so we can follow externally.
Sam (Payments-Eng): Ticket created: BRICK-4789. Assigned to partner-ops. Routing override pushed (effective immediately) — I'll post metrics in #payments-ops when we see the next attempt.
Erin (Support): Noted, passing to customer now. :thumbsup:
